The '''Eedoq system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Eedoq]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|evacuation]] of their [[Arda Base|base]] on [[Arda I]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] regrouped in the Eedoq system after a series of micro-jumps through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to throw off any pursuit. While in the system, [[Senior Advisor/Legends|Senior Advisor]] [[Setenna Hase]] came aboard the Rebel [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Fury of Alderaan]]'' to discuss the establishment of a [[Resolute Base|new base]] on [[Jagomir]].<ref name="OAA">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref>
